lessons.objective: I can spot what makes a sentence just right!
I can blend sounds into whole words, even words with tricky blends!
I can find the first, middle vowel, and last sounds in words, even words with blends!
I can ask a question about a story and find the answer in its words.
I can retell a story in order and find its central message.
I can ask and answer questions about facts in a book.
I can name the main topic of a fact book and retell its key details in order.
I can use tools to figure out what a tricky word means.
I can use the other words in a sentence to figure out what a tricky word means.
I can use word parts like un-, re-, and -ful to help me understand new words.

artifacts.title: Sentence Shapes
artifacts.objective: I can spot what makes a sentence just right!

artifacts.title: Blend Builders
artifacts.objective: I can blend sounds into whole words, even words with tricky blends!
concepts: orally blend three and four sounds into single-syllable words, including consonant blends like st, fl, sn, cl, tr, and sw

artifacts.title: Sound Spotters
artifacts.objective: I can find the first, middle vowel, and last sounds in words, even words with blends!
concepts: isolate and pronounce the first, middle vowel, and last sounds in spoken single-syllable words, including words with consonant blends

artifacts.title: Ask It, Find It
artifacts.objective: I can ask a question about a story and find the answer in its words.

artifacts.title: Story Message
artifacts.objective: I can retell a story in order and find its central message.

artifacts.title: Fact Questions
artifacts.objective: I can ask and answer questions about facts in a book.

artifacts.title: Topic Spotter
artifacts.objective: I can name the main topic of a fact book and retell its key details in order.

artifacts.title: Word Toolbox
artifacts.objective: I can use tools to figure out what a tricky word means.

artifacts.title: Sentence Clues
artifacts.objective: I can use the other words in a sentence to figure out what a tricky word means.
concepts: the other words in a sentence are clues
clue words point to the meaning

artifacts.title: Prefix Power
artifacts.objective: I can use word parts like un-, re-, and -ful to help me understand new words.
concepts: un- means not or the opposite (unhappy, unlock)
break the word into its parts to unlock what it means

items.prompt: Which word starts with a blend?
What is the first sound in ship?
How many legs do ants have?
What is the main topic of our book?
Read it aloud: The dog ran.
